test_id: background path selection and rendering 'background authored path: templated c…'

findings.rationale: The NLSpec explicitly defines this case in section 3.5: a templated canonical body.background with type "html" must preserve the authored text expression while transforming CSS using the body context. Sections 3.1–3.3 also specify recursive body-mode propagation, protection only for the resolved text field, and normal transformation of css. The implementation is therefore failing behavior already unambiguously required by the specification; repeated failure indicates an implementation or integration issue, not a missing requirement.
